briefing: 今日导读：OpenAI获得新一轮110亿美元融资，估值达1.25万亿美元，显示AI市场的热度和资本支持力度。AI数据中心扩张带来环保争议，地区政治影响显现。多个公司发布新AI工具及平台，继续推动AI在各领域的应用深化。
highlights: AI行业今日显现出资本市场的高度认可与金融风险并存的态势，OpenAI的巨额融资和中国团队在CyberGym上刷新纪录显示技术突破与市场乐观情绪。但同时，大规模数据中心的扩张引发了对环境和社会影响的广泛讨论，与此同时，投资者对大规模AI投资的潜在风险表示关注。整体来看，行业发展虽快，但需平衡技术进步与社会责任。

articles.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
articles.text: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg . That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion. Echoing FT and Wall Street Journal reports from last week, Bloomberg says OpenAI is still pursuing additional investments that could increase the amount to $20 billion, and that it had initially hoped to raise as much as $30 billion at a higher valuation of $1.4 trillion. That was before tech stocks dropped, and the results of the midterms showed how much public o … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
articles.text: Massive new data centers are the physical foundation for tech companies’ hopes and dreams for AI. But the rush to expand warehouses full of energy-hungry servers has also kicked up fights across the world over their impact on power grids, utility bills, nearby communities, and the environment. Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead of the 2026 midterms , and voters largely opposed data center expansion at the polls. Tech giants like OpenAI and Amazon are promising to work more closely with local communities and cover their data center energy costs. But following the election, Democratic leaders are calling for further data center restrictions and slowdowns that the AI companies will have to grapple with. From audacious plans about data centers into space , heated local battles over buildouts , and potential environmental impacts , here’s The Verge ’s news, coverage, and reporting surrounding data centers and the companies that are building them.
